title: Table Maintenance
tagline: Add, edit, copy and delete table entries, no SAP GUI needed.
summary: One generic abap2UI5 app shows the entries of a database table and lets you add, edit, copy and delete them, with value helps from check tables, fixed values and search helps, and records the changes on a transport request. It reads the table's structure at runtime, so nothing has to be generated per table. It is for developers and admins who maintain customizing and Z tables, on ABAP Cloud as well as on Standard ABAP, including systems without SM30.
features: Generic maintenance screen built from the table structure at runtime
Edit entries in a popup with value help from check tables, fixed values and search helps
Add, copy and delete entries, multi-edit mode for several rows
Record changes on a transport request
Search field and column layouts via layout-management
Embeddable into a view cluster through the interface z2ui5_if_tm_001
requirements: Standard ABAP on SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP 7.50 or higher
abap2UI5-addons/popups (value help, search help and transport request popup)

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: abap2UI5, abap2UI5-addons/popups, abap2UI5-addons/layout-management, then this repository (branch main)
Start with ?app_start=z2ui5_cl_tm_001&table=<TABLE_NAME>; without the parameter the app asks for the table name first
The app carries no authorization check of its own; add your own before using it beyond a development system
